components.description: Unpaid, job-protected family and medical leave under the FMLA as implemented by VCU's Family and Medical Leave policy: up to 12 weeks in the leave year for the birth of a child, adoption or foster placement, the employee's own serious health condition, or care of an ill spouse, child or parent. Accrued paid leave may be substituted (the department may require it).
components.faculty_group_note: VCU policy: 'All faculty and staff'; HR faculty leave page lists nine- or 10-month and 12-month teaching and research faculty and A&P faculty as eligible
components.eligible_parent_wording: the birth of a child; the placement of a child with the employee for adoption or foster care; the employee's own serious health condition; to care for an immediate family member (a spouse) who has a serious health condition
components.entitlement_note: Statutory entitlement (FMLA); the handbook says the FMLA 'entitles eligible employees to take unpaid, job-protected leave'.
components.duration_note: 12 weeks (60 work days; 480 work hours) in VCU's fixed leave year (Jan. 10 - Jan. 9); prorated for part-time employees. The 26-workweek extension is for care of a covered service member. The benefits brochure (2018_05, revised February 2014) states 'up to 26 workweeks (1,040 hours) in the calendar year' for all qualifying reasons; the governing policy (2018_01) decides: 12 weeks.
components.service_requirement: employed by the Commonwealth of Virginia for at least 12 months and at least 1,250 hours worked for VCU during the 12-month period before the leave
components.dual_employee_rule: both spouses employed by the university: combined total of 12 weeks in a 12-month period for birth, adoption or foster placement or care of the child within 12 months (not for own or family serious health condition)
components.time_window: birth leave to be taken within 12 months after birth; adoption or foster leave within 12 months of placement
components.notice: at least 30 days' advance written notice if the need is foreseeable (expected birth or adoption)
components.medical_certification_note: Certification of Health Care Provider form for the employee's own or a family member's serious health condition; not stated for leave for the birth itself
components.relief_note: Formal leave of absence; no relief stated (R9).

notes: Governing documents for tenure-stream faculty leave exist (the VCU Family and Medical Leave policy, the Faculty Promotion and Tenure Policies and Procedures, the 2017-18 Faculty Handbook, the Leave and Time Reporting and Faculty Sick Leave Reporting policies), so missing is false (the rule for records with no governing document does not apply). The HR faculty leave page (2018_00), the HR FMLA page (2018_06) and the benefits brochure (2018_05) are summaries; details they add to a provision the governing documents contain are used, and provisions found only there are flagged summary_only.

VCU has no parental, maternity or childbirth leave, no paid parental leave, no modified duties and no teaching relief for faculty in the saved documents. A new parent relies on unpaid FMLA leave (12 weeks), own sick and annual balances, and (for VSDP members) VSDP sick leave and short-term disability.

Elective paths: faculty choose the VRS or the ORP at hire; VRS members may elect the VSDP, otherwise the TSLP; ORP members cannot join the VSDP. Both sick-leave paths are coded and not linked to each other (never in_lieu_of, checklist §1). VSDP components carry an ambiguous restriction flag; c3 carries a rule-gap flag because U8 covers paths set by eligibility or residence, not by election.
Leave sharing (c11) and annual leave (c10) are limited to 12-month faculty, so they carry the group name rather than the code.

Conflict: the benefits brochure (2018_05, revised February 2014) says FMLA gives 'up to 26 workweeks (1,040 hours) in the calendar year' for qualifying reasons; the governing FML policy gives 12 weeks, with 26 only for covered-service-member care. Coded 12 (source precedence); c1 flagged conflicting_sources.

FML policy: unpaid FMLA days combined with other leave taken may not exceed 60 work days (480 hours); this is FMLA's own 12-week envelope, not a leave_limits entry. Spouses both employed by VCU share 12 weeks for birth or placement (dual_employee_rule on c1).

Not components: educational leave (half pay or unpaid, for an approved course of study) and study-research leave (eligibility criteria set by each school, for tenured faculty, professional development): neither can be taken for a birth. Administrative, bone marrow/organ donor, community service (school assistance), holiday, inclement weather, military, predisciplinary and workers' compensation leave: not usable for a birth. The handbook's equal opportunity statement names pregnancy, childbirth and parenting status as protected, but grants no leave or accommodation. Handbook 5.3 requires classes to be covered through the chair during a faculty member's extended illness or disability; it is an arrangement, not a separate benefit.

Cited but not saved: State Policies 4.20 (FMLA), 4.35 (Leave Sharing), 4.45 (Leave Without Pay), 4.55 (Sick Leave), 4.57 (VSDP) and the other DHRM leave policies listed in 2018_03 (3.10, 3.15, 4.05, 4.10, 4.15, 4.17, 4.37, 4.40, 4.50, 4.60); VCU 'Leave Types and Guidelines: A Resource for Faculty, Classified Employees, and Timekeepers'; 'Quick Reference for Faculty Leave (Accrual Rates/Maximum Carryover/Payment on Separation)'; VCU Leave Reporting and Timekeeping Manual; Faculty Roles and Rewards Policy; Faculty Salary Administration Guidelines; Annual Assessment of Faculty Performance policy; Study-Research Leave policy; Educational and Training Opportunities policy; Returning to Work After Illness or Injury policy; Accessibility and Reasonable Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities policy; VCU Guidelines for Faculty Track Transfers; school and department promotion and tenure guidelines (which must describe altered probationary periods).
Statutory floor: FMLA 12 weeks applies (U7); the documents rely on it (c1).

Calendar: the documents name fall and spring semesters (sick leave credited 'at the beginning of the fall and spring semesters') without a length: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component uses a term unit.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA unpaid leave 12 weeks from the birth (c1), with own TSLP sick and annual balances concurrent (c6, c10, R1: 0 paid weeks); on the VSDP path, VSDP sick leave from the start (c2, 64 hours) and VSDP short-term disability from week 2 for up to 25 weeks at 60% (c3, concurrent_with c1 with start_offset_weeks 1), then VSDP long-term disability (c4, consecutive_after c3). No employer-paid childbirth or parental weeks.

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA unpaid leave 12 weeks (c1), with own annual leave, family sick leave (c7, 48 hours) and, for 12-month faculty, 33% of the sick balance for FMLA family reasons (c8, summary only) concurrent. No paid parental weeks.

Tenure clock (c15): discretionary extension for extenuating circumstances, a non-exhaustive list (childbirth, adoption, natural disaster, accidents and others): general_purpose by U1, counted in no figure.
